ResearchProjectDef.label: Colonial Fabrication Methods
ResearchProjectDef.description: Discover methods of fabrication of colonial technology.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Carapace Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft carapace armor, a light suit of armor used by most armies. Note that these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Medic Carapace Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft a medic variant of carapace armor with medical supplies. Note that these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Engineer Carapace Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft a engineer variant of carapace armor with tool kits. Note that these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Police Carapace Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft a police variant of carapace armor with handcuffs and pouches. Note that these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Scout Carapace Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft a marksmen variant of carapace armor with a thermal cloak. Note that these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Assault Carapace Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft a assault variant of carapace armor with additional armor. Note that these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Veteran Carapace Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft a veteran variant of carapace armor with additional armor. Note that these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Commander Carapace Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft a commander variant of carapace armor with gold trim. Note that these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Colonial Uniforms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tailor garments often worn by colonial groups. Providing a variety of versatile apparel.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Modified Shields
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build modified shield gear. This shield modifies the momentum-repulsion technology to also prevent heat based projectiles and allowing the wearer to shoot out. At a cost however.

ResearchProjectDef.label: High-Frequency Resonators
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build weapons which use high frequency resonators to create devastating melee damage. Note these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Overclocked Resonators
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft weapons with reinforced structures to handle more powerful resonators, creating larger and more powerful weapons. Note these also require advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Electrothermal-Chemical Munitions
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build weapons which use electrothermal-chemical plasma charges to fire depleted uranium sabots. Note these also require advanced components

ResearchProjectDef.label: Specialized Plasma Charges
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refine the electrothermo-chemical plasma charges to be able to fire larger depleted uranium sabots. Note these also require advanced components
